title: Functions
summary: Package reusable code with def, parameters and return values.

exercises.title: Say Hello
exercises.prompt: Define a function `greet()` that prints `Hello!`, then call it.
hints: Indent the body, then call greet().

exercises.title: Add Function
exercises.prompt: Define `add(a, b)` that returns the sum. Print `add(3, 4)`.

exercises.title: Square Function
exercises.prompt: Define `square(n)` that returns n squared. Print `square(9)`.

exercises.title: Default Parameter
exercises.solution:
def greet(name="friend"):
    return "Hello, " + name + "!"

print(greet())
print(greet("Asha"))

exercises.title: Min and Max
hints: Return two values separated by a comma.

exercises.title: is_even
exercises.prompt: Define `is_even(n)` returning True or False. Read an integer and print `is_even(n)`.
exercises.solution:
def is_even(n):
    return n % 2 == 0

n = int(input())
print(is_even(n))

exercises.title: Recursive Factorial
Fibonacci
exercises.prompt: Write a recursive `fib(n)` where fib(0)=0 and fib(1)=1. Print `fib(10)`.

exercises.title: Variable Arguments
exercises.prompt: Define `total(*nums)` that returns the sum of all arguments. Print `total(1, 2, 3, 4)`.

exercises.title: Count Primes
exercises.prompt: Write `is_prime(n)`. Read an integer n and print how many primes are between 1 and n (inclusive).
hints: A prime has no divisors from 2 up to its square root.
